notes.title: I answer some questions
notes.content:
Hi, Hola, Hallo, Привет! 
[b]I answer some questions:  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38631054/f67559b71a6d431350c9e22b8c5a860295a0b00a.png[/img]

[olist]
[*]  [b]Optimization[/b]
     －in new version , some great player said: "loading times have increased". 
[list]
[*][i]I answer this question.[/i]
　　We are always working on optimization fixes. We will be updating constantly through mini-updates.
       Right now, We are facing Windows/Engine compatibility problems, but  in the near future, it will be fixed. Don't worry.
[/list]
[*]  [b]How long does it take to complete the game in this version?[/b]
[list]
[*][i] I answer this question.[/i]
   It depends on your ability. If you are a skilled player it could take around 25-30 hours, I think.
[/list]
[*] [b]Are there any in-game events that we won't see when it is officially launched?[/b]
[list]
[*][i]I answer this question.[/i]
   YES. Few bonus events will disappear after big launch.
[/list]

[/olist]


You have asked, I have answered. 
That's all. 

[b]Good luck, great players!!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38631054/ac26751e585ef4b55c18bbc7ca83029e6eff25c2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mayor Update Now Available!
notes.content:
How are you guys doing?
We are excited to share with you some amazing news about our update.

First of all We'd like to thank everyone for your amazing support and feedback over these long weeks, remember that you can reach to us via Community Forums or you can leave your Review on the Store page.

Without any further ado, here is the list of the New Changes we made:


[list]
[*] [b]Added a Navigation System (Minimap)[/b]
Have you been stuck? Well, Worry no more, We've got your back, You can see important places to visit and you can follow the Yellow dot to where your next adventure awaits!
[*][b] New System Battle Speed Changer[/b]
Did you felt as if the battles where infinite? Now you can speed up the battle up to 3x the speed it normally took.
[*] [b]New Characters[/b]
I wont spoil you, but, Spoiler alert! They are AMAZING. Come meet them!
[*] [b]We Added a new chapter to the story![/b]
Where did you left off your adventures? Because there is more awaiting for you.
[*] [b]New Maps[/b]
Of course, New story, New Scenery, I'm sure you will love it as much as we do
[*][b] Remake and Improvement of the Following Maps:[/b]
Main Castle Town, School, Market
[*][b] Bug Fixes[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38631054/4a19e11c2d7f2bb8cb342b998b47003db6c8b427.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy this update, we will keep working to make truly an amazing experience for you to play. Stay alert for the next updates and remember to leave your comments down below, we appreciate your feedback, We will stay in touch!

notes.title: Guest live streaming!! >
notes.content:
Hello hello!
Sorry to be late!
We would like to announce that we are doing a LIVE STREAM with a SPECIAL GUEST!!!
Also, we are having a giveaway for a key of "Huusuienbu"

What's going to happen in our live stream??
1.Guest will take on the challenge of treasure hunting. The time limit is 90 minutes.
2.In the meantime, our streamer will interview her and give her tips.
3.Guess how many treasures they will be able to take within the time limit. The one who correctly guess it, will receive the Steam Key for the game!
4.Of course, if you join in the live streaming you are free to ask them a lot of questions and give them tips!

This time, the special guest is.....
Ronix!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38631054/f95f34d07834e0dca61d8fe5931656234636a3b1.png[/img]

She is the Voice Actor for princess Ryokusui.

Don't miss it!!

The Live Stream starts on : March 3rd 16:00 (PST) !!!
See you there!!
